name: 2008 Lehman Brothers Collapse
date_notes: Chapter 11 bankruptcy petition filed in US Bankruptcy Court for Southern District of New York prior to market open.
description: Lehman Brothers files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, triggering a global liquidity crisis and a massive sell-off across global equities.

name: Fukushima Earthquake & Tsunami
date_notes: Magnitude 9.0 earthquake and tsunami struck northern Japan. Nuclear cooling failure at Fukushima Daiichi initiated on same day.
description: A massive earthquake and tsunami hit Japan, causing a nuclear disaster that violently disrupted global supply chains and energy markets.

name: US Credit Rating Downgrade
date_notes: S&P announced downgrade on Friday evening after market close. First global trading reaction session occurred Monday, August 8, 2011.
description: Standard & Poor's downgrades the US federal government's credit rating from AAA to AA+, triggering a violent global stock market sell-off.

name: OPEC US Shale Price War
date_notes: OPEC 166th Ordinary Meeting in Vienna concluded with decision to keep production ceiling at 30 mb/d. US markets closed for Thanksgiving; first US session on Friday Nov 28.
description: OPEC unexpectedly refuses to cut oil production to drive US shale producers out of business, initiating a historic crash in crude prices.

name: Brexit Referendum
date_notes: Polling conducted on June 23; result and historic financial shock occurred on Friday, June 24, 2016.
description: The UK unexpectedly votes to leave the European Union, causing historic volatility in the British Pound and European banking sectors.

name: US-China Trade War Begins
date_notes: Presidential Memorandum on Section 301 investigation signed, initiating up to $60B in tariffs on Chinese goods. Alternative milestone: July 6, 2018 (effective date).
description: The US announces massive tariffs on Chinese goods, sparking retaliatory tariffs that heavily impact global tech, manufacturing, and agriculture.

name: COVID-19 Market Crash
date_notes: S&P 500 reached all-time pre-pandemic peak on Feb 19; continuous crash began Feb 20 as international contagion confirmed. WHO declared pandemic on March 11.
description: Global stock markets begin a severe, rapid crash as the reality of pandemic lockdowns and supply chain halts sets in.

name: Russia Invades Ukraine
date_notes: Military offensive announced broadcast at 05:45 MSK. Missile strikes and ground incursion commenced immediately.
description: Russia launches a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, triggering massive spikes in global energy (oil/gas) and agricultural commodity prices.

name: Silicon Valley Bank Collapse
date_notes: California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation closed SVB and appointed FDIC as receiver after bank run.
description: SVB fails after a bank run driven by the rapid rise in interest rates, briefly threatening regional banking contagion.

name: Israel-Hamas War Begins
date_notes: Attack launched on Saturday (weekend); first global market session on Monday, October 9, 2023 (Tel Aviv traded Sunday Oct 8).
description: Hamas launches a major attack on Israel, triggering a massive regional conflict and escalating geopolitical risk premiums across Middle Eastern markets.

name: Yen Carry Trade Flash Crash
date_notes: Nikkei 225 plummeted 12.4% following BOJ rate hike on July 31 and US payrolls data on August 2, causing massive unwind of Yen carry trade.
description: The Bank of Japan hikes interest rates, triggering a violent unwind of the global Yen carry trade and a massive one-day global equity flash crash.

name: US-Israel Strikes on Iran
date_notes: Staged strikes on Saturday (weekend); first global market reaction session on Monday, March 2, 2026.
description: The US and Israel launch coordinated military strikes on Iranian infrastructure, sparking immediate surges in oil prices and widespread market volatility.
